svg.aria-label: Benchmarks. CampusSlot overlap query at 200,000 bookings: 2,469 pages read before, 30 after a GiST index. Fuze semantic search p50 latency: 3,026 ms to 1,661 ms at best run, 45 percent faster. CampusSlot bad-release drill: failure detected in about 5 s, automatic Helm rollback at 62 s, 0 of 4,800 user requests failed across 3 runs.
